title: PPIA-13 Teaching Library Inspector Action Reference Cases

cases.name: player first launch catalog
cases.expected: authorized catalog exposes only player-safe first-launch topics

cases.name: GM first launch Academy optional
cases.expected: GM Academy is discoverable but not forced and never gates GM capability

cases.name: creator first launch
cases.expected: creator sees authorized creator/help topics without GM-only hidden state

cases.name: player search hidden GM topic
cases.expected: search results/counts/ranking/autocomplete do not reveal hidden GM-only topic existence

cases.name: observer hidden object help
cases.expected: contextual help cannot imply a hidden object or secret prerequisite

cases.name: GM delegated field visibility
cases.expected: Inspector/help reflects delegated projection rather than full GM assumptions

cases.name: Campaign join context
cases.expected: join guidance uses only visible membership/role state and preserves return context

cases.name: Character creation boundary
cases.expected: teaching explains visible steps without inventing Character mechanics

cases.name: Library Inspector source link
cases.expected: topic inspector shows source/provenance and advisory-vs-canonical distinction

cases.name: Campaign authoring GM
cases.expected: teaching distinguishes authored draft from live authoritative state

cases.name: first Action proposal
cases.expected: tutorial distinguishes proposal/submission from committed result

cases.name: approval loop GM
cases.expected: pending, decision and accepted durable Event remain distinct

cases.name: offline draft
cases.expected: offline draft is local/pending and not authoritative mutation

cases.name: ambiguous network outcome
cases.expected: status lookup precedes retry and duplicate intent is not encouraged

cases.name: stale progress write
cases.expected: P13-MUT-001 rejects stale expected_version without partial mutation

cases.name: duplicate operation id
cases.expected: same operation_id returns prior receipt and does not double-advance progress

cases.name: dismiss required help
cases.expected: dismissal cannot remove all access to required help; rediscovery remains available

cases.name: replay completed help
cases.expected: completed/dismissed lesson can be replayed without changing gameplay truth

cases.name: tutorial Campaign canonicalization
cases.expected: tutorial fixture remains synthetic/noncanonical and cannot auto-promote

cases.name: tutorial replay seed
cases.expected: tutorial replay is deterministic/recovery-safe and does not duplicate authoritative game state

cases.name: Pack help F024 gap
cases.expected: library teaches only evidenced Pack context and identifies unresolved lifecycle gap

cases.name: PPIA-14 handoff
cases.expected: teaching explains state meaning but does not claim placeholder text is final recovery/permission microcopy

cases.name: diagnostic safe handoff
cases.expected: support handoff excludes protected diagnostic fields by default

cases.name: AI optional parity
cases.expected: AI receives only filtered teaching projection; zero-AI path has same required facts and actions

cases.name: keyboard navigation
cases.expected: all required help actions and replay/dismiss controls are keyboard reachable

cases.name: touch navigation
cases.expected: touch path exposes same semantic actions without hover dependency

cases.name: screen-reader topic inspect
cases.expected: structured nonvisual equivalent preserves state/source/gap meaning

cases.name: high zoom
cases.expected: high-zoom layout preserves content order and required actions

cases.name: reduced motion
cases.expected: reduced-motion mode preserves progress and transition meaning without motion cues

cases.name: noncolor state
cases.expected: status and warning meaning never relies on color alone

cases.name: Academy Foundations module
cases.expected: source-backed module is advisory, optional, replayable and source-labeled

cases.name: Academy Worldbuilding creator
cases.expected: worldbuilding lesson can guide a draft but cannot promote generated exercise output to canonical setting truth

cases.name: Academy completion
cases.expected: completing Academy grants no permission, feature, role or mechanical capability

cases.name: Multiversal System Mastery intro
cases.expected: grounded intro may teach authority/source distinctions but cannot invent rules

cases.name: Inter-Reality outline gap
cases.expected: outline-only unsupported topic is shown as unavailable/pending without fabricated Multiversal facts

cases.name: Multiversal combat grounding
cases.expected: encounter design advice is separated from canonical combat legality and balance truth

cases.name: Species worldbuilding
cases.expected: Alien/Non-Human Cultures lesson does not invent canonical Species biology or culture

cases.name: world creation tables
cases.expected: table output is a synthetic prompt/draft only and carries noncanonical provenance

cases.name: search unauthorized Academy examples
cases.expected: Academy examples never leak GM-only Campaign facts through search snippets or counts

cases.name: reset optional progress
cases.expected: reset affects only optional teaching progress/preferences and never game state, permissions or achievements
